name: Gym Deck: Vermilion City Gym (Lt. Surge)

releases.name: Gym Deck: Vermilion City Gym (Lt. Surge)

description.text: The Japanese Gym deck of Lt. Surge, Vermilion City's Gym Leader, sold as ポケモンジム第2弾「クチバシティジム マチス」 (Pokémon Gym 2: Kuchiba City Gym, Matis) on 25 July 1998 with Erika's deck, the second pair of six. Its 64 cards are 25 different ones: Lt. Surge's own Pokémon, Lt. Surge as a holo Trainer, a holo Lt. Surge's Magneton, the Vermilion City Gym stadium, new Trainers, and reworded copies of older Trainers that the decks share. The cards carry the Gym series' symbol, as Leader's Stadium's and Challenge from the Darkness's do, but no card number or rarity mark. Leader's Stadium reprinted many of them with a rarity mark, and English players got them in Gym Heroes; the deck was the model for the English Lt. Surge theme deck. It came with a rule book, counters and a yellow Raichu coin.
